entries.summary: Snapshot CRDs enforce source and volume-mode immutability and named, namespaced content references. A VolumeSnapshot class name remains optional for default-class selection, but must be nonempty when specified.
upgradeNotes: **Snapshot automation:** keep sources and source volume modes unchanged, supply complete content references, and omit the VolumeSnapshot class name for default selection instead of passing an empty string.

entries.summary: Added `localStorage.member.extraEnv` for per-Cluster overrides such as host-tool `PATH`; existing member DaemonSets reconcile additions and updates while retaining undeclared variables.

Migration image defaults change `v1.0.4-01` → `v1.2.0` for directory-symlink SFTP errors; `localStorage.migrate.juicesync.version` selects JuiceFS (default `1.2.0`), requiring compatible Local Storage and migration images.
upgradeNotes: **Retained migration tags:** to adopt the update, set `localStorage.migrate.juicesync.tag=v1.2.0`, deploy compatible Local Storage, and start new migration Jobs.
**Selecting JuiceFS `1.4.1`:** avoid this version when device nodes, FIFOs, sockets or OverlayFS whiteouts require preservation; these objects are skipped even with checks.

entries.summary: CRD installation now returns API update failures instead of reporting success when an existing CRD cannot be updated.
Migration checks now default to enabled (`false` → `true`) through new `localStorage.migrate.check`, including reconciliation of existing member DaemonSets.
upgradeNotes: **Checks intentionally disabled:** retain that behavior by explicitly setting `localStorage.migrate.check=false` before upgrading.

entries.summary: Local Storage snapshotter and snapshot-controller defaults change `v6.0.0` → `v8.6.0`, with matching ordinary snapshot CRDs bundled in the Operator image.
upgradeNotes: **CSI upgrades:** deploy the updated chart with the new Operator image; for staged rollouts, retain previous CSI tags until snapshot CRDs reconcile.
**Existing snapshot installations:** verify stored API versions and save custom CRD configuration before the Operator applies replacement schemas.

entries.summary: CSI defaults change registrar `v2.5.0`→`v2.18.0`, provisioner (Local Disk Manager/Local Storage) `v2.0.3`/`v3.5.0`→`v5.3.0`, attacher `v3.0.1`→`v4.13.0`; Local Storage resizer `v1.0.1`→`v1.12.0` and health monitor `v0.8.0`→`v0.18.0`.
Helm defaults change eleven HwameiStor component images `v1.1.1` → `v1.1.3` and UI `v0.17.1` → `v0.17.2`; explicit image overrides remain effective.
Operator builds now use gRPC `1.79.3` instead of `1.38.0`, removing the stale dependency override that kept vendored builds on the older version.
Operator image builds refresh glibc and CA certificates, enforcing minimum versions `2.28-251.el8_10.11` and `2026.2.92_v9.0.319-81.3.el8_10`, respectively, while retaining Rocky Linux 8.
